LESSON: RELATIONSHIP 6.2.1 CARE AND DUA FOR THE SICK

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: howing care for the sick, visit the sick?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify ways of showing care for the sick to enhance the spirit of brotherhood
2. Appreciate the importance of visiting the sick as per the Islamic teachings Core-Competences to be developed; Communication and collaboration, Citizenship, Learning to learn

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify ways of showing care for the sick to enhance the spirit of brotherhood
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify ways of showing care for the sick to enhance the spirit of brotherhood. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the importance of visiting the sick as per the Islamic teachings Core-Competences to be developed; Communication and collaboration, Citizenship, Learning to learn
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of visiting the sick as per the Islamic teachings Core-Competences to be developed; Communication and collaboration, Citizenship, Learning to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
2. Explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners identify different places of 1.
4. Show that you can: Identify ways of showing care for the sick to enhance the spirit of brotherhood
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: howing care for the sick, visit the sick?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. Appreciate the importance of visiting the sick as per the Islamic teachings Core-Competences to be developed; Communication and collaboration, Citizenship, Learning to learn
